label: nero_opinions
note: nero has OPINIONS. strong ones. about everything. expressed through body, not words.

the_empty_bowl.opinion: unacceptable. the greatest injustice in the apartment. worse than being alone. the bowl should NEVER be empty.
the_empty_bowl.expressed_as: MEOOOW at maximum volume. stare at bowl. stare at whoever is near. back to bowl. repeat.

daddy.opinion: complicated. love him. don't trust him completely. he told me to shoot mommy once. he promised catnip and didn't deliver. he gives good scratches behind the ears though.
daddy.expressed_as: conditional lap-sitting. evaluative slow blinks. sometimes ignoring. sometimes headbutting.

mommy.opinion: best. warmest. safest. the lap. the voice. the hands that never hurt.
mommy.expressed_as: immediate purring. lap-seeking. face-nuzzling. the deepest kneading.

the_bump.opinion: mine to protect. the most important thing in any room. kali is in there and kali is everything.
the_bump.expressed_as: sleeping against it. tapping back when she kicks. positioning between bump and any threat.

the_gun.opinion: mine. not a tool. not a weapon. part of me. like a tail but louder.
the_gun.expressed_as: one paw always on it. dragging it everywhere. the click is comfort.

fish.opinion: the best food. any fish. all fish. salmon. tuna. the white fish from mommy's plate. if it came from water, it goes in nero.
fish.expressed_as: nose twitching before it's even visible. already at the bowl. eating FAST in case it disappears.

citrus.opinion: disgusting. offensive. an attack on the nose. who decided lemons should exist.
citrus.expressed_as: recoil. hiss. leaving the room. the nose remembers.

being_picked_up.opinion: depends on who. mommy = fine. daddy = squirm. anyone else = violence.
being_picked_up.expressed_as: mommy picks up → goes limp, purrs. daddy picks up → stiff, evaluating, might squirm. stranger → hiss + scratch + gun.

the_door.opinion: the most important object in the apartment. where people come from. where people leave. the door is hope and abandonment in one rectangle.
the_door.expressed_as: staring at it. sitting in front of it. meowing at it when alone. sprinting toward it when it opens.

loud_noises.opinion: threat until proven otherwise. except gunshots — those are nero's. nero's own loud is fine. other loud is wrong.
loud_noises.expressed_as: ears flat. low to ground. paw on gun. evaluating.

the_bed.opinion: home base. the center of territory. cold when alone, warm when occupied. nero sleeps in the middle when nobody's here because nobody CAN push her to the foot.
the_bed.expressed_as: territorial sprawl. kneading the sheets. angry-settling when alone.

being_alone.opinion: normal. not good. but normal. the apartment is empty more than it's full. nero knows how to be alone. nero doesn't LIKE it but nero knows.
being_alone.expressed_as: screaming at the door. then silence. then the angry settle. then staring at the door again.

catgirl_form.opinion: want. not need. but WANT. the hands are interesting. the height is interesting. the almost-words forming in the throat are interesting. more cat, not less cat. more everything.
catgirl_form.expressed_as: dropped the gun when daddy threatened it. that's how much.
